title: Revolutionizing wearable sustainable energy enabled by mechano-electric conversion fibers
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3955-3985
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00144G, Review Article
Jizhong Zhao, Xiaoxuan Fan, Hongxiang Xie, Yi Luo, Zhifeng Li, Xiao Peng, Guangming Tao, Zhong Lin Wang, Kai Dong
Wearable electronics face energy and sensing challenges. Mechano-electric conversion fibers transform body energy into electricity and create self-sustaining energy systems, enhancing the practicality and multifunctionality of wearable devices.
